# BrainDAW Web

BrainDAW combines stereo brainwave tones, recorded nature, and generative synth pads in one mixer. This release adds 24 factory presets to a searchable library of 30. Browse meditation, focus, sleep, dreamwork, and psychedelic-inspired soundscapes. In-app research notes explain the evidence behind the themes and the limits of audio beat research. Preset names describe sound design.

Open the [hosted studio](https://rmanmetaverse.github.io/BrainDAW/) or serve the contents of `BrainDAW-Web.zip` over HTTPS or localhost. Install the PWA from a supported browser. After the app finishes caching, the included audio and worklets can load offline.

The release workflow verifies the production build, first-click audio, mobile layout, preset and timeline persistence, and offline playback.
